# Machine file import fixtures

These six original test designs were encoded by pyembroidery 1.5.1 from the same coordinate pattern. Positions use tenths of a millimeter. The first thread follows `(-90, 0), (-75, 10), (-60, 0)`, then trims and jumps to `(15, 30), (30, 30)`. After a color change and jump, the second thread follows `(0, -40), (15, -30), (45, -39)`. The two thread colors are `#ED171F` and `#0A55A3`. Standard DST and EXP use display colors on import.

[pyembroidery](https://github.com/EmbroidePy/pyembroidery/tree/1.5.1)
